name: session_finish
title: Clean up after merge
description: Clean up after a merged PR (close related Issues, delete branches, local cleanup)

pr_ref.description: PR reference (`owner/repo/N`, or the short form `N` in the repository of `repo`, or else of the git remote of the current directory)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

closedIssues.description: Issue numbers this command closed; usually empty for a PR to the default branch, since GitHub closes them on merge

reason.description: Why it was not closed: epic (protected), already-closed (including Issues GitHub closed on merge), not-found, or failed (see warnings)

skippedIssues.description: Closing Issues of the PR that this command did not close

location.description: Whether the remote or the local branch was deleted

issue.description: Issue waiting for a closed Issue (#N, or owner/repo#N in another repository)

from.description: Readiness before the merge (blocked, startable, or stackable on #N)

to.description: Readiness after the merge (blocked, startable, or stackable on #N)

readinessChanges.description: Issues waiting for the closed Issues whose readiness changed by the merge

issue.description: Started Issue stacked on a closed Issue (#N, or owner/repo#N in another repository)

branch.description: Branch linked to that Issue, to restack in its working directory (omitted when none)

restack.description: Upper stacked Issues to restack with pr_restack in their working directories

currentBranch.description: Current branch after the local cleanup (omitted when the local cleanup was skipped)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
